d: Deep violet, straight hair falls past the shoulders with long bangs framing the face and small white ribbons tying sections of hair on the sides. Narrow, crescent-shaped eyes are a matching deep violet, set upon a youthful face with a playful expression. The slender build is dressed in a black and red gothic gown featuring a white plunging neckline, long black sleeves, and a flowing skirt with red lining and black diamond patterns at the hem. Black opaque tights cover the legs, completing the ensemble.
